issue.title: check set src is available for default route

failure.body:
**Description**

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
```
admin@vlab-01:~$ ip -6 route list match ::
default proto bgp src fc00:1::32 metric 20
        nexthop via fe80::<IPV6> dev PortChannel0004 weight 1
        nexthop via fe80::<IPV6> dev PortChannel0002 weight 1
        nexthop via fe80::<IPV6> dev PortChannel0003 weight 1
        nexthop via fe80::<IPV6> dev PortChannel0001 weight 1 pref medium
```

```
admin@vlab-01:~$ ip route list match <IP>
default proto bgp src <IP> metric 20
        nexthop via <IP> dev PortChannel0001 weight 1
        nexthop via <IP> dev PortChannel0002 weight 1
        nexthop via <IP> dev PortChannel0003 weight 1
        nexthop via <IP> dev PortChannel0004 weight 1
```
